title: Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Customer Service Coordinator

Temporary to Permanent Opportunity
Near Biggleswade, Bedfordshire
Monday to Friday 9:00am - 5:00pm 100% Office Based
Permanent Salary: 28,000 per annum - neg

Are you passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and building strong client relationships? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two days are the same?

Our client is a prestigious and well-established packaging organisation with an excellent reputation for quality, innovation, and customer satisfaction. Due to continued growth, they are looking to recruit a Customer Service Coordinator to join their friendly and supportive team.

This is a temporary-to-permanent opportunity, with an initial temporary period of up to one month before moving onto a permanent contract for the right candidate.

The Role

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you will play a vital role in supporting customers and distributors, ensuring every enquiry and order is managed efficiently from start to finish. You'll build long-term relationships with customers, identify opportunities to grow existing accounts, and deliver an outstanding customer experience at every stage.

Key Responsibilities
- Build strong, long-lasting relationships with distributors through proactive and professional communication.
- Take ownership of customer enquiries and orders, managing them through to successful completion.
- Process customer orders and quotations accurately within agreed timescales.
- Recommend suitable products and prepare quotations tailored to customer requirements.
- Follow up quotations and provide regular feedback to the Customer Service Manager.
- Identify opportunities to upsell products and maximise customer value.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
- Monitor sales trends and proactively identify opportunities for growth.
- Become fully proficient in the company's internal systems.
- Maintain accurate records and ensure excellent attention to detail at all times.
- Support the wider team and undertake additional duties to contribute to the continued success of the business.

About You

We're looking for someone who enjoys building relationships, solving problems, and providing first-class customer service. You will be organised, motivated, and confident communicating with customers over the phone and via email.

Ideally, you will have:
- Previous experience within a customer service, customer support, sales support or account coordination role.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- A proactive, positive, and results-focused approach.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy workload.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confidence working both independently and as part of a team.
- The ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
- Good IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems.
- A flexible approach and willingness to support the business when required.

What's on Offer?
- Temporary to permanent opportunity.
- Permanent salary of 28,000 - negotiable depending on experience
- Monday to Friday working hours (9:00am - 5:00pm).
- 100% office-based role near Biggleswade, Bedfordshire.
- Opportunity to join a prestigious and growing packaging organisation.
- Friendly, supportive team environment with genuine long-term career prospects.

Whilst temping through Tate

Weekly pay

Holiday pay

Free on-site parking

Access to the Tate Awards Scheme including store discounts

If you're an enthusiastic Customer Service professional looking for your next challenge within a respected and growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Apply today!

Please be aware this advert will remain open until the vacancy has been filled. Interviews will take place throughout this period, therefore we encourage you to apply early to avoid disappointment.

Tate is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

Tate is committed to promoting equal opportunities. To ensure that every candidate has the best experience with us, we encourage you to let us know if there are any adjustments we can make during the application or interview process. Your comfort and accessibility are our priority, and we are here to support you every step of the way. Additionally, we value and respect your individuality, and we invite you to share your preferred pronouns in your application.

title: Repairs Scheduler
description:
Repairs Scheduler

Full Time (37 hours per week)
Location - Bedford (Hybrid Working)
Salary - 28,882.35 per annum

This role is hybrid, working from our head office in Bedford and from home. You will be office-based until fully trained; once competent, you can adopt a hybrid working pattern, to be agreed with the Scheduling Team Leader.

There is a requirement to work a late shift from home (12pm - 8pm). In addition, one week in every four you will work half a day on a weekday and half a day on a Saturday. We can be flexible with this.

Make a real difference in our brand-new in-house repairs & maintenance service

Are you an experienced works scheduler with a background in dynamic scheduling systems and a passion for delivering excellent customer service? Do you want to be part of our in-house repairs & maintenance service, where your work makes a difference to our customers and you're valued as a key member of our workforce? If so, we want to hear from you!

Repairs and maintenance services affect our customers personally, impacting their quality of life and satisfaction with their homes. To provide the very best service possible, we are bringing our repairs and maintenance service in-house.

As a Repairs Scheduler you will be:
- Be a confident people person who works seamlessly with our tradespeople and sub-contractors.
- Scheduling the right colleague for each job and plan daily workloads efficiently and effectively.
- Helping maximise first-time-fix rates and minimise travel between jobs.
- Reducing disruption to customers by planning thoughtfully and communicating clearly.

What We're Looking for in a Repairs Scheduler:
- Experience of logistical planning or other comparable scheduling service.
- An organised approach to work, with a positive attitude and great time management.
- A strong, demonstrable commitment to excellence in customer service through empathetic and considerate approaches to jobs.
- Housing repairs and maintenance knowledge beneficial, but not essential.
- Good communication and IT skills.

Working pattern

Hybrid role: office-based during training, then a mix of office and home working (to be agreed). Late shift 12pm-8pm from home. One week in every four includes half-day weekday and half-day Saturday working (flexible).

Why Join Us?

At bpha, our values are at the heart of everything we do:
- We take responsibility: We do what we say and are accountable for our actions.
- We show empathy: We respect and listen to every colleague and customer.
- We are better together: We value diversity and achieve more as one team.
- We are ambitious: We strive for excellence and make a positive difference.

Employee Benefits

We believe in rewarding our team with more than just a pay cheque. In addition to a wealth of other benefits and as part of our commitment to your wellbeing and development, we offer:
- A competitive salary of 28,882.35 per annum.
- Annual leave entitlement of 28 days (increasing, with length of service to 33 days) PLUS paid bank holidays.
- Generous contributory pension scheme, with up to 12% contributed by bpha.
- Free private health care (family members can also be added at a cost).
- Free life assurance.
- Discounted gym membership.
- A range of free wellbeing services including digital gym and fitness classes.
- Hybrid working.

Are you ready to make a difference?

If you're ready to make a positive impact and develop your career in our team, we'd love to hear from you!

Please note that applications will be reviewed as received and as such bpha reserves the right to close applications prior to the advertised closing date upon identification of a suitable candidate.

Early applications are encouraged to avoid disappointment.

All offers will be subject to satisfactory pre-employment screening, including DBS check and references.

title: Receptionist
description:
Temporary Receptionist

Location: Bedfordshire

Responsibilities:

- Highly organised, flexible, and able to manage multiple priorities.

- Reliable, punctual, resourceful, and helpful, with a full UK driving licence.

title: Receptionist (12 month FTC)

description:

title: Administrator
description:
Proactive Personnel are delighted to be recruiting for a Sales & Purchasing Administrator on behalf of our client, a well-established and growing business based in Sandycroft. This is a temporary role

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and motivated individual to join a busy commercial team. The successful candidate will work closely with the Sales, Purchasing and Import departments and will receive full training and support to develop their skills across all areas of the business.

We are keen to hear from candidates with previous sales or purchasing administration experience, but our client is also happy to consider experienced administrators with strong organisational skills and a willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

As a Sales & Purchasing Administrator, your duties will include:
- Raising sales invoices and purchase orders
- Chasing outstanding customer and supplier orders
- Liaising with both existing and prospective customers, as well as suppliers
- Arranging freight transport for goods supplied to customers across the UK and from suppliers throughout Europe
- Coordinating freight movements and supporting customs clearance processes for imported goods
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring internal systems, customers and colleagues are kept fully up to date
- Providing general administrative support across sales, purchasing and import activities

The Package

The successful candidate will join a thriving and profitable business that offers a supportive working environment, ongoing training and genuine opportunities for career development. Those who demonstrate commitment and strong performance will have the opportunity to take on additional responsibilities and progress within the organisation.
- Monday to Friday, 8:00am to 5:00pm
- Based in Sandycroft, Flintshire (North Wales)
- Convenient location with easy access from Chester, The Wirral, the A55 and M56

Candidate Requirements

To be considered for this role, you should have:
- Previous experience within an administrative role, ideally within a sales, purchasing, customer service or commercial environment
- Experience working with customers and suppliers
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Accurate data entry skills and a methodical approach to work
- Good numerical ability
- Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
- Good IT skills, including experience using Excel, Google Sheets or similar software
- Professional and confident communication skills

Desirable Experience

The following experience would be advantageous but is not essential:
- Sales or Purchasing Administration experience
- Automotive parts industry experience
- Import, freight or customs administration experience

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
CMC Consulting is partnering with a rapidly growing FMCG business in Bedfordshire to recruit for an exciting opportunity within its finance team. This role is ideally suited to an ambitious finance professional looking to broaden their experience in a well-rounded position while continuing to develop their accountancy qualification and progress their career.

Key Responsibilities
- Perform bank reconciliations across multiple accounts and support treasury activities, including funding reconciliations and cash management.
- Assist with month-end processes, including journals, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supplier payment runs.
- Manage supplier recharges, promotional contributions and miscellaneous invoicing, ensuring timely billing and collection of outstanding balances.
- Process employee expenses, ensuring compliance with company policies, VAT requirements and accurate general ledger coding.
- Maintain and update customer and supplier rebate agreements within the ERP system, ensuring commercial terms remain accurate and up to date.
- Liaise with commercial teams to validate rebate data and support the administration of customer and supplier agreements.
- Investigate and resolve finance-related queries while supporting audits, process improvements and wider finance projects.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience within a similar role.
- Strong attention to detail with excellent accuracy and organisational skills.
- Good working knowledge of Excel, including common formulas and data analysis tools.
- Ability to prioritise workload, meet deadlines and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Experience using an ERP or finance system.
- Studying towards, or interested in pursuing, a professional accounting qualification (AAT, ACCA or CIMA).

Send your CV now.

Applicants must be eligible to work in the UK.

CMC Consulting is committed to equal opportunities. We do our best to ensure that the wording used in our job vacancies does not discriminate against any individual in any way. Please contact us if you feel that this is not the case.

title: Purchasing Coordinator - 12 month FTC
description:
Purchasing Co-Ordinator - 12 Month Fixed Term Contract

Safran - Here, we craft excellence together.
At Safran, excellence is a journey - and we'd love you to be a part of it. As a trusted global leader in aerospace, defence, and space, we are proud to be a company where diversity, innovation, and opportunity come together to shape a sustainable future where we can all succeed together through a shared vision.
Safran Electrical & Power is one of the world's leaders in aircraft electrical systems. It is a key player in the equipment electrification & in the electric and hybrid propulsion sector. Mastering the on-board energy system, the company designs and provides modular, innovative and optimised architectures and solutions.

Your role:
The Purchasing Coordinator provides operational and administrative procurement support to the NPI Buring Program team. The role is responsible for executing day-to-day purchasing activities, ensuring timely placement and management of PO's, maintaining effective supplier communication, and supporting procurement reporting and analysis.
The position enables supports the Buying team, who are focused on strategic sourcing, supplier development, negotiations, and program execution by taking ownership of transactional procurement activities and supplier follow-up.
Key responsibilities:
- Purchase Order (PO) Management
- Ensure timely transmission of purchase orders to suppliers
- Obtain and record supplier order acknowledgements
- Maintain accurate purchasing data, pricing information, and delivery commitments within ERP systems
- Monitor open orders and ensure timely updates of delivery schedules
- Support the resolution of invoice discrepancies and coordinate with suppliers and Finance to ensure timely invoice processing and payment
- Monitor inventory levels for prototype and industrialization program, maintaining Line of Balance (LOB) visibility and ensuring material availability to support prototype and pre production builds. Supplier Follow-Up and Expediting
- Act as the primary operational interface with suppliers for order management activities
- Follow up supplier commitments and delivery schedules

What You'll Bring:
- Prior experience in purchasing, procurement administration, supply chain or a similar operational role
- Experience using ERP systems (SAP preferred)
- Experience working in a manufacturing or aerospace environment is advantageous
- Good understanding of purchasing and supply chain processes
- Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications
- Ability to analyze and organize data accurately

We know that some candidates may be put off applying for jobs where they don't meet 100% of the criteria outlined in the advert. We encourage anybody to apply if you can demonstrate a variety of skills and experience relevant to the requirements of this role. Please let us know if you would like to discuss any reasonable adjustments to the hiring process that may better facilitate your participation.
We celebrate our differences and believe they make us stronger. We know that a fulfilling work environment is a key driver for innovative ideas and team success.

title: Team Administrator
description: The countywide Early Intervention in psychosis service are looking for an enthusiastic and team player candidate for a band 4 administrative role to provide high-quality administrative and secretarial support to the Operational Leads and the multi-disciplinary clinical team. The role requires excellent written and verbal communication skills, the ability to work both independently and as part of a team, and strong organisational skills to ensure the smooth and efficient running of the service. The successful candidate will work closely with the Business Support Lead and Team Manager, will contribute to delivering an effective, responsive, and confidential administrative service. They will develop and maintain administrative systems, manage sensitive information appropriately, liaise with a wide range of professionals, and support key operational functions across the team. -Receive and appropriately manage all incoming calls and visitors, ensuring a courteous, helpful, and professional response at all times.-Provide a comprehensive administrative / Secretarial support to the Operational Lead and team/service. Including processing all reports, correspondence and documentation. -Ensure that all incoming post is date-stamped and distributed to the appropriate persons, and that out-going mail is sorted according to internal, external departments and relevant agencies -Check Rio system for weekly admissions/referrals and discharges and sending out reminders for overdue discharge summaries. -Coordinate the collection of and update of patient information on files and on team/service database systems ensuring data quality is monitored and any concerns raised. -Develop and maintain information-gathering systems for the team and as required, prepare reports and audits from the data gathered -Communicating with patients / Staff legal professionals, other clinicians and members of the multidisciplinary team as appropriate -Arrange appointments, clinics and bookings for the Operational Lead service/team. -Communicate effectively with a wide range of people from different backgrounds. Dealing sensitively and tactfully with clients and their parents/carers in person, or on the telephone. -Have excellent verbal, written and communication skills In addition to the above duties, the successful candidate is expected todeal sensitively with service users or their carers/relatives who may be distressed. To exercise judgment when dealing with inquiries and resolve patient problems by providing information and advice regarding appointments or the service as appropriate, or by passing on to the appropriate team member. As required to work flexibly to provide reception and switchboard duties including answering the telephone, taking messages, transferring calls and dealing with clients who may drop in to visit the clinicians. To take and relay clear messages. This includes handling queries from other professionals and obtaining information to enable these to be dealt with as effectively and speedily as possible. To use information technology for a range of purposes To induct new staff to appropriate filing and administration systems Maintain office-filing systems and ensure information relating to service users is accessible to relevant staff, ensuring confidentiality at all times. Book interpreters and translators for clients appointments and monitor confirmation of bookings and action as appropriate. Upload admissions/referrals and discharge and other documents onto Rio and retrieving information/documents from Rio. Provide clerical support to team members including opening, withdrawing, archiving and closure of case records and filing. Report to the Operational Lead Business Support Lead any issues that are of concern relating to health and safety of the building.
